objects/def_3c069320b487.json.name: Player
objects/def_3c069320b487.json.description: The hero, seen from above: walks in every direction with the arrow keys or WASD (no jumping), with a walk cycle for each way.

scripts.name: Party
scripts.description: Shows the party's health and potions (kept from battle to battle) at the top of the screen.

do.text: Knight Lv{game_value('Knight_level', 1)} {game_value('Knight_hp', 24)}/{game_value('Knight_max_hp', 24)}   Mage Lv{game_value('Mage_level', 1)} {game_value('Mage_hp', 16)}/{game_value('Mage_max_hp', 16)}   Gold {game_value('gold', 0)}   Potions {game_value('potions', 3)}

objects/def_f9f5d5d7df7c.json.name: Wall
objects/def_f9f5d5d7df7c.json.description: A stone wall tile. Draw rows and columns of them to make rooms and corridors.

objects/def_6ce106261dcd.json.name: Floor
objects/def_6ce106261dcd.json.description: A floor tile: only a look, drawn under everything. Paint the inside of rooms with it.

objects/def_631853f43136.json.name: Enemy
objects/def_631853f43136.json.description: A slime that wanders around and hurts on contact.

scripts.name: Hurts on touch
scripts.description: Touching it hurts player (1 health a hit).

objects/def_a7fbbef35a33.json.name: Key
objects/def_a7fbbef35a33.json.description: A key to pick up. Doors can require it.

objects/def_d47dff969444.json.name: Door
objects/def_d47dff969444.json.description: A door in a wall, seen from above: blocks the way until it is opened (by a switch, a key or a rule).

objects/def_0d8fb62c2e50.json.name: Switch
objects/def_0d8fb62c2e50.json.description: A lever. Press E next to it to flip it. Make it control a door.

objects/def_2b0804027bdb.json.name: Hazard
objects/def_2b0804027bdb.json.description: Floor spikes, one tile: damage anything that walks over them.

scripts.name: Hurts on touch
scripts.description: Touching it hurts anything with health (1 health a hit).

objects/def_751768dd9d0f.json.name: Teleporter
objects/def_751768dd9d0f.json.description: A teleporter pad. Connect two with "teleports to" (each way for a two-way pair): stepping on one puts the player on the other.

objects/def_cc2a48291939.json.name: Goal
objects/def_cc2a48291939.json.description: Stairs down: reaching them wins the level (play goes on to the next level).

objects/def_15430363b283.json.name: Barrel
objects/def_15430363b283.json.description: A barrel the player can push, one tile per push (for puzzles); it blocks everything else like a wall.

objects/def_2659fabd16b0.json.name: Heart
objects/def_2659fabd16b0.json.description: A heart: picking it up gives back one heart of health (up to the most the player can have). Its look is also the look of the player's hearts on the screen.

objects/def_f2646262fb2d.json.name: Knight
objects/def_f2646262fb2d.json.description: A party member: strong blows, a little magic.

scripts.name: RPG hero
scripts.description: A party member in a battle: Fight, Magic, Potion or Run on its go, then which monster. Health and magic carry over between battles; a win goes back to the map.

objects/def_65c16803bca7.json.name: Mage
objects/def_65c16803bca7.json.description: A party member: weak blows, strong magic.

scripts.name: RPG hero
scripts.description: A party member in a battle: Fight, Magic, Potion or Run on its go, then which monster. Health and magic carry over between battles; a win goes back to the map.

scripts.name: RPG monster
scripts.description: A monster in a battle: on its go it strikes a hero at random. When no hero is left, the party has fallen and the game starts again.

objects/def_f7473574c890.json.name: Bat
objects/def_f7473574c890.json.description: A monster in battles: quick to strike.

scripts.name: RPG monster
scripts.description: A monster in a battle: on its go it strikes a hero at random. When no hero is left, the party has fallen and the game starts again.

objects/def_8cd02e6f4aa8.json.name: Wild Slime
objects/def_8cd02e6f4aa8.json.description: Wanders the map; touching it starts a battle (the Battle level). Won, it is gone.

scripts.name: RPG encounter
scripts.description: On the map: touching it starts a battle (the battle level), and the game comes back to the map as it was. Won: it is gone; fled: it leaves the player alone for a moment.

objects/def_1f0c70ef63bf.json.name: Merchant
objects/def_1f0c70ef63bf.json.description: Sells potions for gold: touching him opens his shop.

scripts.name: RPG shop
scripts.description: A shopkeeper on the map: touching it opens the shop's menu (what is sold, for how much gold); a purchase takes the gold and adds the item to the party's.
